idx_agents_location_node_liveness_revisi.name: idx_agents_location_node_liveness_revision
idx_agents_location_node_liveness_revisi.where: "agents"."location_type" = 'via_node' AND "agents"."location_node_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agents"."status" NOT IN ('offline', 'released')

idx_deliveries_node_retry.name: idx_deliveries_node_retry
idx_deliveries_node_retry.where: "deliveries"."status" = 'queued' AND "deliveries"."route_node_kind" IN ('http_push', 'ws', 'fleet_ws', 'direct_ws') AND "deliveries"."next_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL

idx_deliveries_node_retry_workspace.name: idx_deliveries_node_retry_workspace
idx_deliveries_node_retry_workspace.where: "deliveries"."status" = 'queued' AND "deliveries"."route_node_kind" IN ('http_push', 'ws', 'fleet_ws', 'direct_ws') AND "deliveries"."next_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL
